artworks.title: Professor Huxley, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil drawing of a man facing slightly to the right. The man is seated and his facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent brow, a straight nose, and a closed mouth. He has long, straight hair and is wearing a formal outfit with a collared shirt and bow tie. The background is plain, focusing on the man's face. The drawing is detailed with fine lines capturing the man's features and hair texture.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a standing position, depicting a natural scene. The horizon is subtly suggested towards the top right, with faint lines indicating vegetation or a distant feature. Trees are seen on the left and right sides with flowing lines denoting movement. The sketch-like style features soft, intermittent strokes representing leaves and branches. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black on a beige background. In the distance, the scenery appears blurred, highlighting the focus on the close trees with textured trunks and foliage.

artworks.title: Fagot-gatherers (Les fagottiers)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures carrying bundles of wood in a windswept landscape. The scene captures a moment showing the figures carrying the wood through the windy environment. The wind is depicted through the bending trees in the background, their branches twisting and leaves fluttering. The use of cross-hatching adds depth and texture to the scene. The composition focuses on the physical labor and the elements of nature present.

artworks.title: The Death of Virginia
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of people in an outdoor setting with soldiers, figures, and barren trees. The composition features a central character surrounded by others, some of whom are armored soldiers holding spears, while others are dressed in classical robes. The landscape is rugged with rocky terrain and leafless trees. In the foreground, two cherubic figures appear to be interacting with large instruments or tools next to a tree. The figures are intricately detailed, showing a variety of expressions and gestures. The use of contrast between light and shadow adds depth to the characters and setting, emphasizing the dramatic atmosphere prevalent throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Bacchanal with a Wine Vat
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a grapevine and wine-making scene. The drawing features various figures engaged in activities centered around wine and festivities. A number of figures are entwined with grapevines, while others appear to be serving or consuming wine. Among them, a bearded figure crowns another with grapes. The scene seems to take place outdoors, under a large vine-laden tree. There is a sense of revelry, depicted through the relaxed postures and the interaction between the figures. The detailed engraving captures the classical style, emphasizing musculature and drapery typical of this form of art.

artworks.title: Henry Monnier
artworks.description: The image depicts a monochrome illustration of a man standing. He is facing slightly to the right with his left hand in his pocket. The man has a rounded face, slightly upturned nose, full lips, short curly hair, and is wearing a dark double-breasted coat, trousers tucked into knee-length boots, and a high-collared shirt. The background is plain with sketch lines suggesting depth.

artworks.title: The Coiffure
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's back, showing the upper half of their body. The person is positioned with their back towards the viewer, with one arm raised and the hand touching their hair, while the other arm is not prominently visible. Their facial features are not visible, but the hair appears long and slightly wavy, falling down their back. The person does not appear to be wearing any clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a textured sketch with diagonal hatching lines, suggesting an abstract setting with no distinct objects or scenery.

artworks.title: The Fitting [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch displays the upper bodies of two women with another figure seated with their back toward the viewer in the foreground. The central woman is in a slightly turned position with one arm bent, her hand resting on her opposite shoulder, and delicately drawn facial features with closed eyes and a gentle expression. She has an updo with a side bun. The woman in the background, standing slightly behind and to the left, is also in a similar pose, facing away from the viewer, presenting only the back of her head and her profile. They are both dressed in loosely fitted garments and there are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is minimally detailed with faint abstract benches or walls suggested by light lines. The drawing appears unfinished with visible lines suggesting movement or position adjustments.

artworks.title: The Fitting [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of four standing figures with their upper bodies visible. The figures are arranged with two in the foreground and two in the background. Their facial features are minimally detailed, and only the contours are shown. The two figures in the foreground have their heads slightly bowed. The figures in the background are positioned one behind the other. The figures appear unclothed, with outlines of their bodies drawn. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, suggesting an unfurnished room. A note reading "PH 32" is in the top left corner.

artworks.title: View of Venice
artworks.description: The image shows a view through a detailed metal railing towards a water body leading to a distant horizon. The horizon features a classical architectural structure with a bell tower and a large dome. The artwork uses sketch-like brushstrokes with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of a single hue. The detailed foreground and background architecture create depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Susan on a Balcony Holding a Dog [recto]
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a balcony, looking sideways. She wears a patterned dress, a hat with a ribbon, and has her dog lying on her lap. The background shows a balcony railing and distant buildings. The sketch includes textured details and incomplete edges.

artworks.title: Susan on a Balcony Holding a Dog [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with their upper body visible, positioned slightly turned to the side. The person's facial features are delicately rendered with closed eyes and a serene expression, and they have short hair peeking out from under a large, elaborate hat that covers part of their face. They are wearing an intricately detailed garment with patterns, and their attire includes a prominent ruffled collar. Resting on their lap is a small animal. The background suggests they are sitting on a balcony or similar outdoor structure, with vertical bars and a faint suggestion of a city or building skyline in the distance.

artworks.title: The Picture Book (No. 1)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a woman and a child visible from the waist up, positioned closely together. The woman is seated with her head slightly tilted, looking downward, with her hair styled in an updo. The child is nestled into the woman's embrace, with long hair cascading over her shoulders, also looking downward. The woman has closed eyes and the child's face is relaxed. Both appear to be wearing simple clothing. They are focusing on an unseen object or book in front of them, and the background is plain with visible sketch lines.

artworks.title: The Picture Book (No. 1)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of two individuals' upper bodies. The person on the right is slightly turned, with their head close to the head of the person on the left. Both have their eyes closed. The person on the right has styled back hair, while the person on the left has shoulder-length hair. They are wearing clothes with high necklines and appear to be holding an object between them. The background is plain, and the edges of the image are framed, directing attention to the pair's serene expressions and close contact.

artworks.title: Peasant Mother and Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a partial view of a person's face, from the forehead to the upper lips. The person is facing slightly to the side, with a forward gaze. The facial features are delicately sketched, showing young features with detailed eyes, a small nose, and a mouth. The hair is short with straight bangs in dark, fine strokes. The sketch is minimalist, with no clothing or accessories visible, set against a textured background with a lightly shaded border. The initials "m. c" are signed in the lower right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Italy (Souvenir d'Italie)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon. In the distance, there is a structure resembling a castle or fortress on a hill. On the right, there are tall leafless trees with detailed branches. On the left, smaller bushes or trees are visible. The sky has a few wispy clouds. The etching style uses delicate lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is sepia tones.

artworks.title: Dire... que nous avons un fils qui est... avocat...
artworks.description: The image shows three people in a sketch-style scene. They are positioned as follows: two on the left are facing away and slightly to the right, while the person on the right faces towards the viewer. The man on the left has outward-styled, receding hair and wears a formal coat with tails. Next to him, a woman with a bonnet or head covering wears a long, ruffled dress. Both are looking at the central figure, who wears legal robes, holds a large book or folder, and wears a cylindrical hat typical of academic or legal attire. The background features a plain wall with a framed picture and a doorway or hallway.

artworks.title: Allant gouter ce qu'on est convenu d'appeler...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a rural winter landscape. The drawing depicts multiple figures sitting in a carriage or wagon, passing through a barren winter landscape. The figures are huddled together and dressed in heavy clothing. The background includes sparse, leafless trees with bold, sketchy lines. The figures have somber expressions and the clothing is heavily shaded.

artworks.title: Madeleine-Bastille
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of a public omnibus with passengers seated or standing. A figure stands in the center, gripping a horizontal support bar above. Other individuals are seated with voluminous clothing filling the space. The detailed line work and shading emphasize the cramped conditions of public transportation. The expressions and postures of the individuals convey a sense of crowding and discomfort. The drawing captures a moment of everyday urban life with a touch of humor and caricature.

artworks.title: A travers les ateliers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures observing artwork in a studio setting. The image depicts several figures examining a large canvas. The figures are positioned closely together, and a palette sits on a small table. The drawing uses dynamic lines and shading to convey expression and movement. The background shows framed art on the walls and potentially a bust or sculpture.

artworks.title: Le Nouveau Paris
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a street scene. On the left, a group of men wearing tall top hats and formal attire stand together, with overcoats and bow ties. They have serious expressions with distinct features and some have sideburns. Nearby, a woman in long garments stands next to them, wearing a bonnet. In the middle, a man in full profile rushes to the right while looking back over his shoulder. He wears a long coat and a round hat and appears to be shouting. To his left, another man tries to control an agitated horse, evident from its raised front leg and rearing posture. The background shows a busy urban street with buildings, people on foot and horseback, and carriages or wagons. The scene conveys a moment of activity and congestion in a city setting.

artworks.title: Paysagistes au travail (Landscape Artists at Work)
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white illustration showing two people resting on the grass in the foreground. In the background, there are umbrellas and easels in an outdoor painting setting. The horizon is mid-image with hills and trees. Tall, narrow trees are on the left. The brushstrokes are defined, emphasizing line and form. The color palette is monochrome in shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: En v'la un, il pourrait bien être malheureux...
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an interior scene resembling a bar or tavern. It features a counter with glass bottles and drinking glasses, decorations on the walls, including a clock. A person is drinking from a large glass, while another individual with a distinctive hat stands nearby holding a pipe. The drawing focuses on the facial expressions and postures of the figures, conveying a sense of interaction. The intricate details of clothing and expressions suggest everyday life and social engagement. The black and white rendering highlights light and shadow play, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: En Chemin de fer... un voisin agréable (On the Railroad: A Pleasant Neighbor)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals sitting from the waist up. The man on the left is seated with his arms crossed over his chest. He has a stern-looking facial expression, a prominent mustache, and a thick beard. He wears a top hat and his hair appears long beneath it. His clothing includes a formal jacket and vest. Beside him, a woman sits upright with her hands clasped on her lap. She has a long face with prominent cheekbones and appears to be looking toward the window. Her hair is styled underneath a bonnet adorned with lace and a ribbon. She wears a formal dress with puffed sleeves and a high collar with a bow. The interior suggests they are inside a train carriage, marked by wooden paneling and a window with an exterior landscape visible. The background is filled with swirling clouds of smoke.
